fragments.plaintext:
Fresh on the heels of similar complaints about OpenAI from mathematicians, a biologist says Anthropic’s Claude “discovered” the same system his team has spent years researching while sharing their unpublished work with Claude.

It’s no longer just publishers & artists accusing AI labs of building plagiarism engines.

fragments.plaintext:
OpenAI is urging the US to lead global technical standards for frontier AI, including recursive self-improvement, pointing to aviation and financial stability as precedents for cooperation without giving up national authority. This comes days after Trump said he'd reject safety concerns to avoid slowing the industry, and a week after Anthropic proposed its own safety framework.

Industry is asking for guardrails faster than governments are agreeing to set them. What would it take for…
